notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR entry gives registration and refuge background but no tower history; the Forest Lookouts page has only a heading; no build date, height, builder or photos were found in two searches and seven page reads. Standing status comes from the FFLOS Illinois list. The brief records Forest Lookouts coordinates (40.363, -89.9911) that differ from NHLR and FFLOS (about 40.3646, -89.9999); the Forest Lookouts page I read showed no coordinates, so that difference is unverified and was not used. Access is unknown.
